title: UnitsCommand
responsibility: Register unit registry inspection, validation and contract authoring commands.

inputs.name: registerUnitsCommand.program
inputs.description: Commander program receiving the units command tree.

inputs.name: units contract --input
inputs.description: Optional testing replaces the declared standard cases after candidate schema validation; omission keeps the current testing metadata.

outputs.name: registerUnitsCommand
outputs.description: Registers index, check, list, contract, show, graph, retire, schema and tests commands. The contract command writes one validated manifest after parsing all provided fields.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Invalid files, contract or testing input, unknown fields, missing or retired units and invalid manifests fail before the contract command writes.
